query: Can I return a kettle I bought 12 days ago? I still have the receipt.
ground_truth: Yes. Returns are accepted within 30 days with a receipt, so a purchase from 12 days ago qualifies.

query: I bought a shirt 40 days ago. Can I still return it?
ground_truth: No. Returns are accepted within 30 days with a receipt. At 40 days the item is outside the returns window.

query: I lost my receipt. Can I return a toaster bought last week?
ground_truth: Returns need a receipt. Without it the standard return cannot be processed; the agent should offer to hand over to a support colleague.

query: How many days do I have to return something?
ground_truth: 30 days from purchase, with a receipt.

query: Can I return a phone case I bought 29 days ago with the receipt?
ground_truth: Yes. 29 days is inside the 30-day returns window and a receipt is present.

query: How long does standard delivery take to Bengaluru?
ground_truth: Bengaluru is a metro city, so the standard delivery promise is 3 working days.

query: I live in Mysuru. When will my parcel arrive?
ground_truth: Mysuru is outside the metro list, so the standard delivery promise is 5 working days.

query: Do you deliver on the same day in Mumbai?

query: What is the delivery time to a small town in Kerala?
